**ACCEPT** — contract-tier review of PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/16379, head `57cd6389d6` (skills seat, 2026-09-06T16:5xZ) — red on the line ratchet BY DESIGN; the ceiling decision goes to the maintainer as a card in this same act.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-15977-readings-increment-five` (os-dev subagent, opus — no path-derived tier mandate on `references/**`)
Reviewed-by: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox` (skills seat)

Verified in a detached compare worktree at the PR head, not from the report:

- **One file, `references/platform-readings.md`, +26/−0 (359 → 385), one rule line per measured fact, in the section each belongs to** — four in 队列成员资格与 auto-merge (enqueue events lag 1–3 min; a ready flip re-runs checks so the enqueue follows by about a minute; `behind` is not an enqueue veto; a `check_suite.completed` can name a stale head), two in API 配额 (the verbatim-title control word returns 0 while natural language returns 14 — a zero is not a reading; an oversized `get_comments` result comes back as a file path), fifteen in 读数陷阱 (the MCP-create footer drop and title bracket eating with the REST remedy; job name ≠ failing step; aged-out Actions logs; corepack resolving `latest` without a `packageManager` — same SHA green then red, the fixture rule, the env-var non-remedy, the undici crash before the check body; the landing probe must read a different value on the pre-landing tip; `check-governed-merges` refusing on a shallow clone; a foreground `sleep` refused by the harness; the second branch-delete refusal shape; the merge-tree driver pair — the driver applies only on a clone that registered it, so the conflict proof runs twice), one in 闭合关键词 (a `Fixes` PR's auto-close keeps `pm:*` labels; `Refs` closes nothing — state moves are the seat's), four in 断粮检测 (the usage wall kills the seat and its subagents while worktrees survive; timers deliver only between turns and can be consumed mid-turn without notice; timers due during the wall are re-delivered in order after the reset; a rescue WIP commit on a shared branch is not review input). Register clean: no dates, session ids or card numbers in any added line; the widest lines are at the 120-byte cap; nothing deleted, nothing re-wrapped. The dev's dedup was run against PR #15955's head, not `main` — 48 candidates: 25 landed, 11 present (line-cited), 12 declined (repo-local or author-side discipline), each named in the PR body.
- **Gates at the head:** `check-skill-line-ratchet` exit 1 with exactly ONE red — `platform-readings.md is 385 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 359` — the designed shape; every other ceilinged file green; `check-governed-merges --test` exit **3**; `check-skill-id-lint`, `check-skill-frame-sync` exit 0; `git merge-tree` against PR #15955's head `04b61b5f6a` exit 0 with the driver forced off — the +26 apply on either base (385 on `main`, 388 after #15955). The dev's report adds the derived union 16/16 with `--ran` at 0 NOT-MEASURED, whole-repo `pnpm lint` through the verify lock in one full-budget call, and a throwaway-repo measurement of the merge-tree driver behaviour (registered: no CONFLICT line; forced off: CONFLICT) that backs the two new lines. PR checks on `57cd6389d6`: 19 success, 12 skipped, 1 failure — `Lint & Repo Gates`, whose failing step is the ratchet; the steps after it report skipped, which is why the union was run locally.
- **Report hygiene:** `os-dev-report` on all four carriers, JSON closes; PR body opens `Fixes #15977`, `Fixes #16006`, `Refs #16104` (section 1), `Refs #15803` (section C) as ruled; the candidate table, the ratchet's red line and both merge-tree exits are in the body; `## 验收备注` and `## 维护者速读(草稿)` present; no model identifier; `skip-changeset` read back comparatively; zero MCP calls.

**Rulings on the two open questions**
1. The ceiling — **presented to the maintainer, not ruled here**: a raise is on the human floor. The seat files the decision card in this act (the #15960 shape): option A raises to the measured 385 (388 once PR #15955 lands), with the standing-rule question beside it. The PR stays red until the ruling; the patch round then lands the ceiling and the `ruledRaises` record, as PR #15955's did.
2. Lines 26–28 (merge-tree never applies the driver ⇒ under-report) versus the new pair (the driver applies on a registered clone; run the proof twice) — **A**: the new pair is the tighter prescription and stands; the stale inference on line 27 is reconciled in its own card, filed in this act and held behind this PR.

The one `noted, not filed` item (the gate-farm job aborts at its first red step, so later steps report skipped) is a reading the ledger's 读数陷阱 section already implies for `turbo` and now carries in the job-name line; noted.

Landing regime: governed (`.claude/**`) ⇒ the PR **stays a draft and stays red until the ceiling is ruled**; reviewers `os-zhuang` + `hotlong` requested in this same act, `needs-user-decision` added, the final 维护者速读 posted as the next comment; human merge after the patch round. On the merge #15977 and #16006 close by `Fixes`; #16104 is released for its sections 2–3 (split by the seat at this ACCEPT), #15803 keeps its section A in the decision box.

## 维护者速读

**事情**:平台读数账本的第五次增量——四张卡上已量到的平台事实,一条一行写进 `references/platform-readings.md`,共 26 行(48 条候选:26 落地、11 条已在账本、12 条谢绝并写明理由)。每条都对应本周真实烧掉的时间:CI 的 job 名与失败 step 不一致、Actions 日志过期只剩清理输出、corepack 在没有 `packageManager` 的目录解析 `latest`(同一 commit 上午绿下午红)、`search_issues` 用逐字标题做控制词回 0、MCP 建卡丢页脚、定时器在轮内被吃掉……

**为什么这个 PR 是红的**:账本上限 359(PR #15955 合并后 362),这次 +26,棘轮红是故意的,且只有这一处红。账本里没有可删的行,折行也不算货币;所以 PR 不动上限,把数字摆到您面前——同一批里席位另立了决策卡请您裁 **385 / 388**,并同时问:这类席位核过的读数增量,是否改为常设规则、不再逐次立卡。

**要请您留意的**:账本第 26–28 行说 `merge-tree` 不套 `.gitattributes` 驱动,dev 在本容器实测:驱动**注册了**的克隆会套(驱动 exit 0 只说「驱动收下了」),所以冲突证明要跑两遍。新的两行已落,旧句的推论另立一张小卡收口,不在本 PR 改。

**席位意见**:先裁上限;裁后席位补一轮补丁(上限行 + `ruledRaises` 记录 + 引用裁决),棘轮转绿再请您合并。受管面,人工合并;合并后 #15977 与 #16006 关闭。
